subject: Business Models
title: Platform Rules and Trust
description: A micro-lesson that makes Platform Rules and Trust usable.

hook.text: Airbnb reviews seem simple. But without them, strangers would never sleep in each other's homes.

buildup.text: Platforms must create trust between strangers. Reviews, ratings, and verification systems do the heavy lifting.

discovery.text: eBay's feedback system turned anonymous internet strangers into trusted trading partners in the late 1990s.

twist.text: Fake reviews are a billion-dollar industry. Amazon removes millions yearly, but new ones appear daily.

climax.text: Trust is a platform's most valuable and fragile asset. Lose it, and both sides flee.

punchline.text: Stars build trust. Fake stars destroy it. Governance matters.

quiz.question: Why are review systems critical for platform businesses?
